subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link-preview support run signal-cli `updateConfiguration`, how should unset/top-level/per-account semantics work, and what security boundary applies to preview metadata?
rationale: The code path is identifiable, but default behavior, linked-device failure handling, and untrusted URL metadata handling are product/security choices rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Add explicit safe support
options.body: Implement unset-preserves-current Signal config, document true/false behavior, handle primary-device failures deliberately, and pass only caller-supplied preview fields.

options.title: Defer behind security design
options.body: Keep this open until the broader link-preview metadata security issue settles whether OpenClaw may fetch or transform preview metadata.

options.title: Reject Signal config surface
options.body: Decline first-class OpenClaw config and leave link-preview behavior to operator-managed signal-cli state or external scripts.

recommendation.title: Add explicit safe support
recommendation.body: Implement unset-preserves-current Signal config, document true/false behavior, handle primary-device failures deliberately, and pass only caller-supplied preview fields.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Signal send/config/docs history and already provided maintainer-facing review context on this issue.
